cases.verified_disposition: Spot-check pass. The candidate represents the required success callbacks, ordinary terminal-error state/rethrow, cancellation distinctions, and batched cache/observer notification path. No material source contradiction found.
primary_source: query/packages/query-core/src/query.ts:594-609: active fetch is reused unless the data-present + fetchOptions.cancelRefetch condition cancels it.
query/packages/query-core/src/query.ts:731-810: revert/silent cancellation, success setData plus success/settled callbacks, ordinary error dispatch plus error/settled callbacks and rethrow.

cases.adjudication_note: The phrase 'unless a requested refetch cancels it' compresses the data-present and cancelRefetch conditions. It does not assert that every concurrent fetch cancels, so it is not a material contradiction; a more exact label would name those conditions.
